title: Hydraulic requirements for load-switched two-speed machine slide
scope_statement: Validated scope: generic hydraulic component classes, functional valve behavior, and direct port-to-port connectivity only. Pump/cylinder/reservoir sizing, pressure and flow ratings, line selection, filtration, cooling, prime mover selection, simulation and fabrication approval are explicitly deferred to the later sizing and engineering phases.
design_narrative: Open-circuit hydraulic topology for a machine-slide feed using a catalog-workaround hi-lo supply. Tank.S supplies two fixed-displacement pumps. The high-flow pump feeds the combined pressure line through an unpiloted pilot-operated check used as a plain isolation check, and also feeds a pressure-threshold sequence-valve bypass to tank used as the unavailable unloading-valve workaround. The low-flow pump feeds the combined pressure line directly. The combined pressure line supplies a tandem-center 4/3 DCV and a main relief valve to tank. The DCV drives a double-acting cylinder directly for powered advance and return. All selected hydraulic ports are connected; no electrical or mechanical-drive interfaces are added.

selected_components.name: Tank
selected_components.role: Open-circuit reservoir boundary providing suction to both pumps and common return for valve returns, relief flow, bypass/unloading flow, and pilot return.
configuration: Tank.S is reused as common suction source for HighFlowPump.S and LowFlowPump.S.
Tank.R is reused as common sink for ReliefValve.T, DCV.T, SequenceUnloader.A, SequenceUnloader.T, and IsolationCheck.X.

selected_components.name: Pump
selected_components.role: High-flow/low-pressure branch of hi-lo supply for rapid approach; unloaded to tank after load-caused pressure rise.
configuration: Fixed-displacement pump instance for the rapid-approach flow portion.
Outlet feeds the isolation check and the pressure-triggered bypass/unloading path.
selected_components.selection_basis: Supports simple hi-lo fixed-displacement approach requested by the brief; exact displacement and pressure capability are sizing tasks.

selected_components.name: Pump
selected_components.role: Low-flow branch that remains connected to the combined pressure line for slower working feed after high-flow branch unloading.
configuration: Fixed-displacement pump instance for working-feed flow.
Outlet connects directly to the combined pressure line feeding the DCV and relief valve.
selected_components.selection_basis: Provides the residual feed flow after pressure-triggered high-flow branch unloading; exact displacement is a sizing task.

selected_components.name: Pilot-Operated Check Valve
selected_components.role: Catalog workaround for a plain check valve isolating the combined pressure line from the unloaded high-flow branch.
configuration: V connects to HighFlowPump.P branch and C connects to the combined pressure line so V-to-C is free flow during approach.
Pilot X is returned to Tank.R so C-to-V reverse flow remains blocked for check-only workaround behavior.
selected_components.selection_basis: Closest available class for one-way high-flow branch isolation because a plain check_valve class is not available.

selected_components.name: Hydraulic Sequence Valve with Reverse Check
selected_components.role: Catalog workaround for pressure-operated unloading/bypass of the high-flow pump branch to tank when load pressure rises at workpiece contact.
configuration: P connects to the high-flow pump branch upstream of IsolationCheck.
A connects to Tank.R as the bypass/unloading outlet.
T drain connects to Tank.R.
Threshold behavior represents the load-caused approach-to-feed transition; setting is deferred to sizing/commissioning.
selected_components.selection_basis: Only available pressure-triggered hydraulic valve suitable as a catalog-level workaround for load-responsive high-flow branch bypass without an electrical pressure switch.

selected_components.name: Relief Valve
selected_components.role: Main system pressure limiter to tank for the combined pressure line.
configuration: P connects to the combined pressure line fed by LowFlowPump.P and IsolationCheck.C.
T connects directly to Tank.R.
Pressure limit corresponds to the stated maximum system pressure requirement; exact setting validation is a sizing/commissioning task.
selected_components.selection_basis: Required safety function for overpressure protection and pressure limiting.

selected_components.name: 4/3 Solenoid DCV, Tandem Center
selected_components.role: Directional control valve for powered cylinder extension, neutral, and powered retraction.
configuration: P receives combined pump pressure line from LowFlowPump.P and IsolationCheck.C.
T returns directly to Tank.R.
A drives Cylinder.Cap for slide advance in the extend state.
B drives Cylinder.Rod for slide return in the retract state.
Neutral provides P-to-T pump unloading with A and B blocked; not relied on for hose-burst- or leakage-safe holding.
selected_components.selection_basis: Provides bidirectional actuator control with a neutral unloading path compatible with fixed-displacement pumps.

selected_components.name: Double-Acting Cylinder
selected_components.role: Linear actuator for machine slide fast approach, working feed, and full return.
configuration: Cap port connected to DCV.A for extension/advance through the workpiece.
Rod port connected to DCV.B for retraction/return.
Stroke/travel realization and areas are deferred to sizing.
selected_components.selection_basis: Required powered linear actuator for the stated slide motion and return.

connections.notes: Common reservoir suction to high-flow pump.
Common reservoir suction to low-flow pump.
High-flow pump branch feeds the free-flow direction of the isolation check.
High-flow pump branch also feeds the pressure-triggered bypass/unloader inlet.
Checked high-flow branch outlet connects to the combined pressure line feeding the DCV.
Low-flow pump outlet connects directly to the combined pressure line feeding the DCV.
Checked high-flow contribution is connected to the combined pressure line protected by the relief valve.
Low-flow pump outlet is connected to the combined pressure line protected by the relief valve.
Relief valve discharges overpressure flow directly to tank return.
Sequence/unloader bypass outlet returns high-flow branch flow to tank after threshold opens.
Sequence/unloader drain returns directly to tank.
Pilot port is returned to tank so the pilot-operated check behaves as an uncommanded check valve.
DCV tank port returns actuator flow and neutral unloading flow to tank.
DCV work port A drives cylinder cap end for extension/advance.
DCV work port B drives cylinder rod end for retraction/return.

function_implementations.circuit_pattern: Open-circuit supply with 4/3 directional control of a double-acting cylinder.
function_implementations.how_requirements_met: Tank supplies both pumps; combined pump pressure feeds DCV.P; DCV.A connects to Cylinder.Cap for powered advance and DCV.B connects to Cylinder.Rod for powered return.

function_implementations.circuit_pattern: Catalog-workaround hi-lo hydraulic two-speed feed with pressure-triggered unloading.
function_implementations.how_requirements_met: Both pump flows combine during low-load approach through LowFlowPump.P and IsolationCheck.C. When resisting load raises pressure, SequenceUnloader opens the high-flow branch to Tank.R and IsolationCheck blocks reverse flow from the combined pressure line, leaving LowFlowPump to provide slower working feed.
ReliefValve.P is connected to the combined pressure line and ReliefValve.T returns to Tank.R, providing system pressure limiting during overpressure or stall conditions.

DCV extend state connects P-A and B-T; retract state connects P-B and A-T; neutral connects P-T with A and B blocked for fixed-pump neutral unloading, while not being treated as safety-rated load holding.
Cylinder converts hydraulic flow to linear slide motion; Cap side is used for advance and Rod side for return. Bore, rod, stroke, and speed/force sizing are deferred.
The approach-to-working-feed phase change is performed by a hydraulic pressure-threshold valve connected to the high-flow pump branch rather than by an electrical pressure switch.

No load-holding element is selected in the current topology because no suspended, overrunning, no-creep, hose-burst retention, or power-loss holding requirement is stated. If later orientation or load data show vertical/inclined/aiding-gravity/overrunning behavior, suitable actuator load holding must be added.

design_decisions.decision: Use two fixed-displacement pump instances as a hi-lo supply.
design_decisions.rationale: Combined flow supports fast approach, and the low-flow pump remains as the working-feed source after the high-flow branch is unloaded. The brief prefers a simple fixed-displacement supply and gives no explicit standby efficiency requirement.

design_decisions.decision: Use a 4/3 tandem-center DCV for actuator control.
design_decisions.rationale: It provides extend, retract, and neutral states. Tandem-center neutral gives pump-to-tank unloading compatible with fixed-displacement pumps, while the blocked work ports are not treated as safety-rated holding.

design_decisions.decision: Use a double-acting cylinder directly connected to DCV work ports.
design_decisions.rationale: A double-acting actuator provides powered advance and powered return for the machine slide. The normal hookup uses DCV.A to the cap end and DCV.B to the rod end.

design_decisions.decision: Implement load-responsive fast-to-feed transition hydraulically with a hi-lo topology.
design_decisions.rationale: Both pump flows combine at low load. Load-pressure rise opens a pressure-threshold high-flow bypass to tank so the low-flow pump alone continues working feed. This avoids an electrical pressure-switch-commanded changeover.

design_decisions.decision: Use GENERIC_SEQUENCE_VALVE_WITH_REVERSE_CHECK as the high-flow unloading workaround.
design_decisions.rationale: The catalog does not include an unloading_valve. The sequence valve is the closest available pressure-triggered hydraulic element for representing high-flow branch bypass to tank, but detailed validation is required.

design_decisions.decision: Use GENERIC_SINGLE_PILOT_OPERATED_CHECK as the high-flow branch isolation workaround.
design_decisions.rationale: The catalog does not include a plain check valve. Connecting V to the high-flow branch, C to the combined line, and X to tank preserves free V-to-C flow and blocks reverse C-to-V flow for the intended check-only behavior.

design_decisions.decision: Provide a main relief valve from the combined pressure line to tank.
design_decisions.rationale: The relief valve limits system pressure by diverting excess flow from the pressure line to tank; its final setting must satisfy the pressure ceiling and sizing calculations.

design_decisions.decision: Do not add actuator load-holding valves in this topology.
design_decisions.rationale: The stated load is resistive and no no-creep, suspended-load, hose-burst, power-loss holding, or overrunning-load requirement is stated. This must be revisited if slide orientation or load data change.

catalog_gaps.capability: Pressure-operated high-flow pump unloading to tank for a hi-lo circuit.
catalog_gaps.reason: The best functional match for the load-caused fast-to-feed transition is a pressure-operated unloading valve, but unloading_valve is not an available catalog type. The selected sequence valve can represent a pressure-threshold bypass only as a catalog workaround and must be validated by the detailed designer.
catalog_gaps.chosen_workaround: GENERIC_SEQUENCE_VALVE_WITH_REVERSE_CHECK used as SequenceUnloader with P on the high-flow branch and A returning to tank.

catalog_gaps.capability: Plain one-way isolation check after the high-flow pump branch.
catalog_gaps.reason: A hi-lo pump circuit normally uses a plain check valve to prevent the low-flow/high-pressure branch from backfeeding the unloaded high-flow branch, but check_valve is not an available catalog type.
catalog_gaps.chosen_workaround: GENERIC_SINGLE_PILOT_OPERATED_CHECK used as IsolationCheck with V-to-C free flow and X returned to tank so reverse flow remains blocked.

assumptions: SequenceUnloader senses the pressure at its P port internally; no external pilot port is available in the selected catalog metadata.
Returning IsolationCheck.X to Tank.R is acceptable as the catalog workaround for keeping the pilot-operated check uncommanded.
The combined pressure line is represented by repeated direct component-to-component edges rather than by a manifold or tee component.
Exact cylinder areas, pump displacements, relief setting, sequence/unloader setting, and speed/force verification are sizing tasks.
open_issues: Slide orientation and overrunning-load risk are unspecified. If later found vertical, inclined with aiding gravity, or otherwise overrunning, add suitable actuator load holding; DCV neutral alone is not sufficient for hose-burst- or leakage-safe holding.

Neutral behavior, emergency-stop behavior, duty cycle, contamination control, cooling, and return-speed expectations are unspecified and may affect later detailed design outside this topology selection.
The sequence-valve-as-unloader and pilot-check-as-plain-check workarounds require detailed hydraulic validation because the exact unloading_valve and check_valve classes are absent from the catalog.

Cylinder bore/rod area must be calculated so the required force plus losses is achieved without exceeding the pressure ceiling; pump flows must be selected so combined and low-flow-only operation meet the target approach and working-feed speeds.
The hydraulic switchover pressure must be derived from actuator area and transition load so unloading does not occur prematurely but switches promptly at workpiece contact.

research_coverage.summary: The accumulated evidence is sufficient to proceed with a safe, unambiguous hydraulic topology. The findings include cited guidance for the open-circuit power unit, relief-to-tank overpressure protection, return/filtration/reservoir path, double-acting cylinder with 4-way directional control and neutral-center choices, and a purely hydraulic load-pressure-dependent hi-lo pump/unloading-valve pattern for fast/slow force switching without an electrical pressure switch. Remaining uncertainties are implementation/sizing details rather than topology blockers.

items.rationale: Covered with cited connection guidance for reservoir-to-pump suction, pump outlet to pressure/supply line, relief valve from pressure line/manifold P to tank, directional valve return to reservoir, return-line filtration, and cooling/reservoir functions. Evidence includes textbook and technical citations with explicit excerpts for pump suction/supply, return line, relief valve operation, return filtration, and reservoir/cooling functions.

Covered with cited guidance that a double-acting cylinder uses one 4-way directional valve to extend/retract, with A-to-cap and B-to-rod port hookup. Evidence also supports a 3-position 4-way valve for neutral behavior and discusses open-center/tandem-center neutral choices for fixed-displacement pump systems, including leakage/creep limitations relevant to safe neutral design.

Covered for topology purposes by cited hi-lo circuit guidance: a two-pump arrangement with relief valve, unloading valve, and check valve can provide fast approach, high-force work stroke, and fast return. The evidence supports the essential components and placement principles for automatic pressure-based transition from high-flow/low-pressure travel to low-flow/high-pressure feed. Exact speeds are a sizing task based on cylinder area and pump flow, not a missing topology claim.

Covered with cited evidence for a purely hydraulic, load-pressure-dependent switching pattern. The hi-lo circuit evidence states that an unloading valve diverts the high-volume/low-pressure pump to tank when system pressure rises above its setting, and that a check valve after the high-volume pump isolates the high-pressure circuit. This directly supports automatic fast/slow switching from load pressure without an electrical pressure switch; the specific 2.5 kN and 12.5 kN transition pressures can be set by cylinder sizing and unloading-valve setting.

Covered with cited evidence that a relief valve opens above a preset limit and returns excess fluid to reservoir to maintain safe pressure, plus a catalog example of relief protection from pressure port P to tank T. This supports a main relief valve set to the required 20 bar to limit stall pressure. Achieving 12.5 kN at 20 bar is a cylinder-area sizing requirement, not a separate missing topology pattern.

missing_or_weak_information: Exact actuator bore/rod sizing, pump flow rates, and valve settings must still be calculated to achieve approximately 1.5 m/min at 2.5 kN, 0.5 m/min at 12.5 kN, and 12.5 kN at no more than 20 bar.

If the slide has vertical or overrunning loads, additional load-holding/counterbalance provisions may be required; the current evidence flags this generally but the machine orientation/load case is unspecified.
Return filtration, cooling capacity, reservoir sizing, and contamination class are design-sizing/specification tasks not fully resolved by topology research.

checks.name: generic_catalog_identity_and_scope
checks.details: Every instance must resolve to an allowed generic functional class; accessories and sizing hardware are forbidden.

checks.name: direct_port_accounting
checks.details: Every generic hydraulic port must participate in at least one direct edge; repeated ports represent branches.

checks.name: minimum_functional_inventory
checks.details: Tank, pump, relief, actuator and directional-control functions checked without accessories.

checks.name: functional_path_reachability
checks.details: Suction, pressure, relief, return and both actuator work paths checked across possible valve states.

checks.name: topology_requirement_coverage
checks.details: Functional assignment, behavior drivers, hydraulic sequencing and topology-scoped gaps checked; all sizing checks are deferred.

design_issues.description: The hydraulic two-speed concept is functionally appropriate, but the selected SequenceUnloader is a sequence-valve workaround for a true hi-lo unloading valve. The topology is acceptable only if this generic sequence-valve implementation can act as a stable pressure-threshold bypass/unloader for the high-flow pump branch after workpiece-contact pressure rise, rather than reclosing/hunting or reintroducing high-flow feed. This is a functional validation item for the workaround, not a sizing issue.

design_review.summary: No blocking functional topology errors found. The circuit provides open-circuit suction/return paths, combined hi-lo pump supply, pressure limiting to tank, powered extend/retract through a 4/3 DCV and double-acting cylinder, and a hydraulic load-pressure-caused fast-approach to slow-feed transition without an electrical pressure switch. Load holding is not required for the stated resistive, orientation-unspecified slide duty. The only concern is the recorded catalog workaround for the unloading valve, which must truly support stable high-flow branch unloading.

validation.summary: Deterministic validation: valid. Engineering review: valid. No blocking functional topology errors found. The circuit provides open-circuit suction/return paths, combined hi-lo pump supply, pressure limiting to tank, powered extend/retract through a 4/3 DCV and double-acting cylinder, and a hydraulic load-pressure-caused fast-approach to slow-feed transition without an electrical pressure switch. Load holding is not required for the stated resistive, orientation-unspecified slide duty. The only concern is the recorded catalog workaround for the unloading valve, which must truly support stable high-flow branch unloading.
